pin.estimand: minted at filing time — no preregistration existed for this row
admissibility_gates: none declared — attempt minted at filing time

attempt.note: not a preregistration — record created retroactively so the row is joinable; mint-before-spend evidence does not exist for it

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: mean token_delta within each tokenizer over all pairs; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful-English mappings preserving the proposal exclusions, written independently rather than shortened to target a prior value
estimand.population: the 32 frozen complete pairs in this manifest

manifest.method: For each named tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) minus len(encode(english)) without special tokens for every complete pair, then take the arithmetic mean. File the maximum tokenizer mean as value and the minimum/maximum means as value_lo/value_hi.
manifest.population: 32 fresh complete pairs, balanced 16/16 across the two forms
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Fresh subjects and predicates spanning software, institutions, transport, science, finance, and physical operations; no complete pair copied from either prior manifest; controls written independently before tokenization.
